{{Quote|We're innocent! My name is Hondu Firewell, and my wife is Tattyra. We're zoologists from Corulag. We only wanted to study the animals of your world.|Hondu Firewell|<ref name="Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls">''[[Star Wars Adventures 2: The Cavern of Screaming Skulls]]''</ref>}}
'''Hondu Firewell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. He and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Tattyra Firewell|Tattyra]] were both [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologists]], and they had a son named [[Klay Firewell|Klay]].

In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], the Firewell family took a trip to [[Fondor]]'s [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nallastia]] to study its fauna, but they were mistaken for poachers and [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Calvaria]]. They were only rescued when a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] team was [[Mission to Fondor (Separatist Crisis)|able to find]] the [[Lost Stars of Nallastia]], after which they returned to Corulag.
